sections.title: Bug Fix Patch
sections.description: This is a bug fix patch and contains no hero updates. In-Game Replay Codes and Highlights from the previous patch are removed.

blocks.title: General
blocks.body: - Fixed an issue where text chat was displaying unintended colors.

blocks.title: Stadium
blocks.body:
Orisa

- Fixed an issue where Orisa's Energy Javelin cooldown was not properly reduced when using cooldown-related mods.

Kiriko

- Fixed an issue where Kiriko's "Clone Conjuration" power failed to grant her clone increased health based on ability powers.
